hero.title: Crafting Gowns to Fit Every Curve Perfectly
hero.subtitle: We don't just tailor Ao Dai. We study body movements to create the most comfortable, flattering silhouette for every woman.
hero.measureText: Our professional fit specialists take a minimum of 12 distinct measurements to ensure a perfect second-skin fit.

pain.title: Why Off-the-Shelf Ao Dai Can Be Uncomfortable
pain.description: Many women hesitate to wear Ao Dai due to tight armholes, restricted breathing while sitting, or awkward fit. AODAI resolves these pain points with advanced tailoring techniques.

armhole.title: Tight Armholes
armhole.text: Narrow cuts or rigid lines prevent you from lifting your arms comfortably or moving naturally.

belly.title: Exposed Waistline
belly.text: Fitted fabrics without flexible ease can make you feel self-conscious and restricted when sitting down.

fit.title: Generic Size Charts
fit.text: Mass-produced sizing templates fail to accommodate the beautiful diversity of real body shapes.

pain.solutionText: We re-engineered the armholes, waist ease, and slit points to ensure your Ao Dai is both stunning and comfortably wearable all day.

fit.title: Designed for Diverse Silhouette Profiles
fit.description: We analyze and design patterns around distinct body profiles to ensure personalized, optimal fit.

slender.label: Slender Profile
slender.note: Optimizing natural body curves and the elegant drape of silk panels.
slender.before: Flat front panel, vertical folding around shoulder lines, and loose waist definition.
slender.after: Enhanced bust silhouette, seamless shoulder drape, and refined, clean waist definition.
slender.imageAlt: Ao Dai on a slender figure

curvy.label: Curvy Profile
curvy.note: Smart ease added at armholes and smooth, flexible transitions around hips.
curvy.before: Restricted armhole movement, horizontal tension lines across hips, and tight waist pressure.
curvy.after: Comfortable armhole with +2cm ease, hidden waist pressure, and flexible hip ease.
curvy.imageAlt: Ao Dai on a curvy figure

atelier.title: The Care and Craft in Every Single Seam
atelier.description: Every single AODAI gown passes through the skilled hands of our most experienced artisans.

founder.title: Linh An
founder.story: My goal is to merge traditional hand-embroidery with modern 3D pattern drafting, making custom Ao Dai accessible to modern women.

tailor.title: Ms. Mai Hanh
tailor.story: The beauty of Ao Dai lies in perfectly aligned seams and understanding how to guide the grain of silk along curves.

cutting.title: Mr. Hoàng Nam
cutting.story: Pattern cutting dictates the flow of the dress. Even a variance of a few millimeters can alter the natural movement of the panels.

testimonials.title: Cherished Moments with AODAI
testimonials.description: Read stories from women who wore our custom-designed gowns during the most meaningful moments of their lives.

wedding.imageAlt: Customer wearing red wedding Ao Dai
wedding.quote: My burgundy lotus wedding gown made me feel extremely proud. The custom fit was flawless, and the hand-embroidery was exceptionally intricate.
wedding.name: Khanh Linh

graduation.imageAlt: Customer wearing white graduation Ao Dai
graduation.quote: Wearing the mulberry silk gown for graduation, I felt comfortable all day in the summer heat and every photo turned out beautifully.
graduation.name: Hoang Yen

tet.imageAlt: Customer wearing Tet brocade Ao Dai
tet.quote: Our family gets custom Tet gowns here every year. The brocade has a premium texture and elegant motifs. Everyone complimented our spring photos.
tet.name: Mrs. Thanh Hang

engagement.imageAlt: Customer wearing pastel engagement Ao Dai
engagement.quote: The modern pastel gown was elegant and kept the dignified coverage needed for my engagement ceremony. Highly recommend!
engagement.name: Thu Huong
